# Headword

> Headword is an iPhone app for people who already speak English and want to use more exact words at work. One new English word a day arrives as a full dictionary entry (definition, register note, two examples, IPA and a recorded pronunciation, synonyms, opposites, collocations), and practice makes you produce it: type it, spell it from its sound, choose it for the tone, say it aloud, write your own sentence. Spaced repetition (FSRS) brings words back before you forget them.

Who it is for: non-native professionals who work in English every day (starting with Spanish speakers), and native speakers who read widely. Upper-intermediate English or better; not a beginner's course.

Facts:
- Platform: iPhone only, iOS 18 or later. Widgets for Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy. No Android, no iPad layout.
- Interface: English and Spanish (Latin America). The words taught are English.
- Words: a little over 4,000, chosen for usefulness at work, not rarity.
- Free forever: the daily word, saved words and collections, widgets, notifications, unlimited practice of the word on screen, one Review session a day, the word games (daily grid, Guess the word, Letter by letter, Letter ring).
- Headword Plus (US prices): $2.99/month, $29.99/year, $99.99 lifetime; 7-day free trial on monthly and yearly for eligible readers. Adds 5 or 10 words a day, topics, unlimited Review, the next word on demand, full history, custom collections, past grids, unlimited Letter ring hints and no ads.
- No account needed. Ads only in the Letter ring game, for readers without Plus, non-personalised.
- Content: definitions, etymologies and pronunciations from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0); examples, register notes and practice material written for Headword.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6807881378 (Headword: Word of the Day)
- Maker: Menyin Chang. Contact: support@headwordapp.com
